fnol_text: My name is Felix Vasquez and I live at 971 Juniper Street, Springfield, OH 45528. You can reach me on (555) 440-3369 or felix.vasquez@example.com. On 2 July 2026 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00131. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Vasquez on (555) 440-3369 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 2 July 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Noor Varga gave a statement by phone.
Felix sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
